fee_scope: Current published Tier 1 ceiling, held constant; no owner tier, volume discount or historical fee-vintage claim
slip_scope: Invented 1 bp per order-side historical spread/impact assumption, not measured historical liquidity
capital_scope: USD already on venue: half cash reserved for spot purchase including worst-cost entry; half cash in separate USD derivative wallet; no spot collateral offset, transfer or borrowing
gap_scope: Missing funding is unknown. Bounds assume the current instrument relative cap held historically and reference prices fall within captured surrounding index-bar highs. Neither assumption certifies the omitted settlements.
decision: One continuous fixed-quantity hold per asset; monthly attribution only; no parameter or best-asset selection
gate_scope: Exploratory economic screen only; exact executable net remains unknown even on a model pass
